# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** the "rose-red" girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a dark-eyed young woman who won the beauty prize among the Second Year classes at Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

She is contemplative, creative, and driven scholar. Possessing a heart brimming with yearning dreams and imaginations, her thoughts are described as light and multicolored.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- contemplative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- creative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- driven  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Mabel attended Regent's Academy where she belonged to a close circle of contemplative and driven scholars alongside Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis. During her studies, she was awarded the beauty prize for the Second Year classes. She maintained a correspondence with Nell Harcourt via letters.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c11 P5](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0005), [v2 c19 P63](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0063)_
